error[ZBX-E0806]: a build step's output is refused
  cause  step "compile" left a FIFO at /out/run/control; an output holds only
         files, directories and links
  fix    have the step remove it, or make it somewhere other than /out
  more   zbx explain E0806 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0806.html
